final: WITH linked_orders AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.orderspivot, o.ordertune FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark), type_counts AS (SELECT ordertune, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM linked_orders GROUP BY ordertune), shares AS (SELECT ordertune, order_count, 1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share FROM type_counts), above_average AS (SELECT order_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average FROM shares) SELECT SUM(order_count) AS summed_counts, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average) AS average_excess_share FROM above_average WHERE share > overall_average
